title: Work from home
subtitle: 「在家工作／遠端工作／遠距工作／混合工作」，究竟是哪一種 work from home？
description: 「在家工作／遠端工作／遠距工作／混合工作」，究竟是哪一種 work from home？

words.note: 使用者提供，也是 work from home 最核心、最常見的近義表達之一。work remotely 強調工作地點不在傳統辦公室，可能是在家、共享空間、咖啡店或其他地點，因此比 work from home 更廣。
words.example: Many employees work remotely several days a week.

exercises.original: She works from home three days a week and goes to the office on the other two.
exercises.zh: 她每週三天遠端工作，其餘兩天回辦公室。
exercises.upgrade: work remotely · 遠端工作；遙距工作

options.explanation: office contrast shows the core meaning is working away from the office, not necessarily only at home.
較正式、政策化，強調利用通訊／數碼工具在主要工作場所之外工作。 但本題的具體線索是 working away from the office on designated days；這句真正要表達的是「離開主要辦公室工作的廣義安排」。因此 telework 雖然與 work from home 相近，工作地點、制度層級、數碼協作重點或是否包含辦公室出勤並不最吻合。
把遠端工作視為一種安排、制度或工作模式。 但本題的具體線索是 working away from the office on designated days；這句真正要表達的是「離開主要辦公室工作的廣義安排」。因此 remote working 雖然與 work from home 相近，工作地點、制度層級、數碼協作重點或是否包含辦公室出勤並不最吻合。
明確以家為工作基地，比 remote working 更窄。 但本題的具體線索是 working away from the office on designated days；這句真正要表達的是「離開主要辦公室工作的廣義安排」。因此 home-based working 雖然與 work from home 相近，工作地點、制度層級、數碼協作重點或是否包含辦公室出勤並不最吻合。
只表示不在主要現場工作，地點未必是家。 但本題的具體線索是 working away from the office on designated days；這句真正要表達的是「離開主要辦公室工作的廣義安排」。因此 off-site working 雖然與 work from home 相近，工作地點、制度層級、數碼協作重點或是否包含辦公室出勤並不最吻合。
部分遠端／在家、部分回辦公室的混合安排。 但本題的具體線索是 working away from the office on designated days；這句真正要表達的是「離開主要辦公室工作的廣義安排」。因此 hybrid working 雖然與 work from home 相近，工作地點、制度層級、數碼協作重點或是否包含辦公室出勤並不最吻合。

falseSynonyms.zh: work remotely 更廣，可以在家、共享空間或其他地方；work from home 明確指定家中。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She works from home on Fridays. He works remotely while travelling.

falseSynonyms.zh: telework 較正式、政策化；日常對話通常更自然說 work from home / work remotely。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The agency has a telework policy. I work from home twice a week.

falseSynonyms.zh: homeworking 是英式較正式的名詞；work from home 是更自然的動詞片語。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Homeworking is available in selected roles. I work from home on Mondays.

falseSynonyms.zh: off-site working 只表示不在主要工作現場，可能是在客戶地點或其他場所，未必是家。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Engineers sometimes work off-site. She works from home full time.

falseSynonyms.zh: virtual working 強調線上協作／數碼工具；work from home 只說地點，未必代表高度 virtual collaboration。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The international team relies on virtual working. He works from home doing independent analysis.

falseSynonyms.zh: hybrid working 必須同時包含遠端／在家與辦公室出勤；完全在家工作不是 hybrid。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She works from home two days and in the office three days. He works from home full time.

falseSynonyms.zh: freelance 描述僱用／合約關係，不描述工作地點。自由工作者可在辦公室工作；僱員也可在家工作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She works freelance for several clients. She is an employee who works from home.

falseSynonyms.zh: self-employed 描述就業身份，不等於居家工作。自僱人士可以在店舖／工作室工作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He is self-employed and runs a workshop. She works from home for a large company.
